verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev tasks are triggered via SDK/API calls from backend code (not GUI-dependent), support GitHub Actions deploy workflows for CI/CD, have a dedicated CLI, cron-based scheduled tasks, and no execution timeouts—all enabling fully headless/automated operation. Community evidence confirms real-world usage as background job infrastructure integrated into existing apps/CI without manual intervention. Missing for 10: no explicit independent report of running the full pipeline (trigger+deploy+monitor) purely in a CI pipeline end-to-end, and no dedicated 'headless mode' documentation beyond CLI/GitHub Actions references.
